newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN RETAIL SALES ON THE SLIDE IN FEBRUARY.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN RETAIL SALES ON THE SLIDE IN FEBRUARY.

text.p: Turnover of Romanian retail trade companies slipped by 4.1 percent in February from the previous month as the population's consumption declined, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed.
It said February's retail sales were 20.7 percent down from the same month of 1996.
Retail trade dropped by 17.4 percent over January-February, when sales of food products, beverage and tobacco saw a 24.4 percent fall from the same period last year.
The private sector accounted for 70 percent of February's retail trade, down from 71 percent the previous month. NOTE -- Changes in comparable prices.
